Title: Azure Data Factory visual tools integrated with GitHub

Body.Content:
Azure Data Factory visual tools are now integrated with GitHub (public and enterprise). The GitHub integration helps you collaborate with other developers, do source control, and version your data factory assets (pipelines, datasets, linked services, triggers, and more).

For more information, read the blog post.
